text: Upset that her widowed father has remarried, a Tokyo schoolgirl called Gorgeous takes six friends to her aunt's country house for the summer. There, [the house begins to eat them|threat|evil places]: a severed head flies out of the well, a piano bites off fingers, and a lamp swallows a flying kick. The aunt, who [died waiting for her fiancé to come back from the war|wrong|loss that won't heal], now devours unmarried girls, watched over by [her cat Blanche|images|animals and birds]. By morning, [Gorgeous is waiting in a kimono to greet her stepmother|ending|victims become the evil].
